settings.label: Size chart link
settings.info: Default for all products. A product can override it with a custom.size_chart metafield (page reference or URL).

settings.label: Custom colors
settings.info: Maps a Color/Colour option value to a HEX color or an image filename already uploaded to Settings > Files. Format: <Color>: <HEX color or filename>, one per line. Used when a color has no native Shopify swatch or metaobject entry.

settings.label: Free shipping threshold
settings.info: Amount in your store's currency (e.g. 79) shown on the cart progress bar. This does not read your Settings > Shipping and delivery rate automatically — keep it in sync manually when that rate changes. Leave blank to hide the bar.

settings.label: Default store image
settings.info: Used when a store has no photo available.

settings.label: Hidden stores (one per line)
settings.info: Enter a store's English name exactly as it appears on the Find a Store page (case and spacing don't matter) to hide it. Takes effect immediately, no code changes needed. Example: Shanghai Songjiang Incity
